title: docs(pm-dispatch): contract-review's SELF-REVIEW row says which mode can reach it
body:
Fixes #18382

`references/contract-review.md` :37 carries the SELF-REVIEW predicate. It compares the
machine-read independence pair defined one and two rows above it: `Implemented-by:` and
`Reviewed-by:`. Under `mode:subagent` the left value is a BRANCH and the right one is a
session id, so the two grammars are disjoint and the predicate cannot fire — by
construction, not by accident. That is the design (the dispatching seat reviews its own
subagent-built PRs in-seat at the review tier; independence is the served tier plus the
record), and the predicate guards the `mode:remote` case, where a dev session would sign
its own diff. The row did not say so, so a seat reading it believed the check applied to
it. This re-keys that one row in place.

The predicate itself is untouched, the pair stays machine-read, and `SKILL.md` is not
opened.

## The row, before and after

Before, on the merge base:

```text
- 两者同 session ⇒ 报 SELF-REVIEW;值紧跟冒号,前置词即不可读;两行皆无的历史裁决恒静默。
```

After:

```text
- 两者同 session ⇒ 报 SELF-REVIEW;只 `mode:remote` 可达,`mode:subagent` 席内审是设计;值紧跟冒号。
```

## The byte table

The file is at its ceiling (60 / 60 lines, 120 bytes per line), so the scope statement is
paid for by deleting measured content from the same row — no new line, no re-wrap. Row :37
held 117 B before, i.e. 3 B of headroom, and the row above it (:35, the independence pair)
holds exactly 120 B, i.e. none — which is why :35 was never a candidate. Every number below
is `Buffer.byteLength(row, 'utf8')` on the whole line including the `- ` bullet.

| # | candidate | bytes | cap 120 |
|---|---|---|---|
| R0 | the row on the merge base (baseline) | 117 | fits |
| A | the card's suggested spelling, both tail clauses kept in full | 183 | over |
| B | full scope + 「值紧跟冒号,前置词即不可读」 in full, legacy clause dropped | 140 | over |
| C | full scope + 「两行皆无的历史裁决恒静默」 in full, colon clause dropped | 139 | over |
| D | full scope + 「两行皆无恒静默」, colon clause dropped | 124 | over |
| E | full scope + both tail clauses cut to their cores | 140 | over |
| F | full scope + 「值紧跟冒号」, legacy clause dropped — **PICKED** | 118 | fits |
| G | full scope only, both tail clauses dropped | 102 | fits |
| H | scope telegraphed to 「限 `mode:remote`,席内审是设计」, both cores kept | 117 | fits |

"Full scope" above is 「只 `mode:remote` 可达,`mode:subagent` 席内审是设计」 — the two halves
the card asks for: which mode can reach the predicate, and that the in-seat review of the
other mode's output is the design rather than a hole.

Why F. Rows B, C, D and E are the arrangements that keep either tail clause whole or keep
both in reduced form; all four are over, so there is no fitting spelling that keeps both.
G fits with more slack but deletes a second rule for nothing. H is the only fitting
spelling that keeps both tail cores, and it buys them by cutting the scope down to
「限 `mode:remote`,席内审是设计」 — a second half with no subject and a first half that
never says what is limited, which is the exact failure mode this card is about. F is the
maximum-retention row that states the scope completely.

What F deletes, and why those two. 「前置词即不可读」 is the rationale tail of the colon
rule; the executable half 「值紧跟冒号」 survives it. 「两行皆无的历史裁决恒静默」 goes
entirely: with the scope statement present, no arrangement of the row keeps it, and of the
two tails it is the one whose loss cannot mislead anyone into a wrong act — it says that
NOTHING happens for a record that carries neither line, while an author who has not read
「值紧跟冒号」 writes a pair that the carrier checker reports as half-written. The fact
itself is not lost from the system: `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs` carries the
legacy-silence statement in the finding text its authorship reader prints, and the silence
is what its reader does by construction.

## Does anything machine-read this row

`scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs` — the checker that emits the record template and
reads this pair — does NOT read `contract-review.md` from disk: it has no path constant,
no `join`/`resolve`/`__dirname` and no `readFileSync` of it (its one `readFileSync` takes a
caller-named payload file). It quotes rows of this file inside its own comment prose and
its own message strings, and its self-test asserts on those strings, not on the file.

Zero-hit with its control: `git grep` over the tree for this row's literals
(「两者同 session」, 「值紧跟冒号」, 「两行皆无」) returns exactly one hit each — the file
itself. The control word is another row of the same file: 「复核记录 = 一条评论落 PR 或卡」
(:27) returns four hits, three of them inside `check-clause2-carriers.mjs`. So the grep is
capable of finding a pinned row, and the row this PR re-keys is not one.

The checker does cite this file by LINE NUMBER in its header prose (:28, :35). This PR
changes no line count, so those citations still land where they did. Its self-test is green
on this branch.

## Verification

Final commit `c09122a9d` — every reading below is pinned to it.

Ratchet verdict for this file, quoted from the gate's own output:

```text
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md: widest table row is 0 bytes (pin 0; headroom 0).
✓ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md is 60 lines (ceiling 60; headroom 0).
```

The per-line byte verdict is printed by that gate ONLY on failure, so its green is a
silence. An ablation makes the silence falsifiable: row :37 was padded from 118 B to 188 B
on disk (marker grep count 0 then 1; mutated blob `6def7c964` differs from the HEAD blob
`b62d90f63`), the gate went red naming the row —

```text
✗ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md has 1 line(s) over the 120-byte budget: L37 (188B).
```

— and the restore leg put the file back byte-identical (`git hash-object` back to
`b62d90f63`, marker count back to 0, `git diff HEAD` empty) with the gate back to exit 0.
Predicted direction was "turns red"; that is what was observed. The mutation was run from
the committed state, under a `trap ... EXIT INT TERM` restoring an absolute path against
`HEAD`, and it leaves no file behind.

Gates. The list is `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, run in the worktree; the list was identical before and after merging `origin/main`. All 15 were run and each exit code recorded before any pipe, then reconciled:

```text
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 15 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 15 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 15 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).
```

| gate | exit |
|---|---|
| `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs --self-test` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` | 0 |
| `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` | 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:agent-test-spelling` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:doc-authoring` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:driver-memory-census` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:nul-bytes` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:refd-timer-probe` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:watch-hint-literal` | 0 |

On the first pass `check:doc-formula-expressions` exited 3 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET, its own
wording, because `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` were unbuilt in a fresh
worktree. That is NOT MEASURED, not a finding; both packages were built through the shared
verify lock and the gate then exited 0. The table records the measured run.

Two more, named by the dispatch: `node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --self-test`
exits 0 (689 cases), and `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on this PR's one
path answers GOVERNED (exit 3, its GOVERNED code). The PR therefore stays DRAFT: no ready
flip, no queue, no auto-merge from this seat.

Local scope. There is no package build or test to run: the diff is one line of
`.claude/**`, which no package's `files[]` ships. Repository-wide scans (`pnpm lint` and the
wide-population gate families `dispatch-gates` declines to place) are CI's run, not this
one's.

No changeset: `.claude/**` is on the `skip-changeset` fast path — nothing published moves.
The label is applied on the card.

## Acceptance notes

Out of scope, noted, not filed:

- `check-skill-line-ratchet` prints its per-line byte verdict only when a line is over
  budget, so a passing file's byte scan leaves no line in the log at all — the two lines it
  does print are the table-row pin and the line count. Not a defect (the gate's exit code is
  the verdict); worth knowing when quoting it as evidence, which is why the ablation above
  exists. Carrier: any PR that quotes this gate as proof of a byte budget.
- `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` cites rows of `contract-review.md` by line number in its
  header prose. Those citations are not machine-read and nothing reconciles them, so they go
  stale the first time a row is inserted or removed in this file. This PR does not move any
  line, so none of them is stale today. Carrier: the next PR that changes this file's line
  count.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— `references/contract-review.md` 第 37 行原地重写一行,60 / 60 行不变,该行
118 B(上限 120)。新增的是这条规则的适用范围;删掉的是同一行里两段尾巴:一段是「值紧跟
冒号」的理由说明,一段是「历史裁决恒静默」整条。谓词本身、机读的 `Implemented-by:` /
`Reviewed-by:` 对、以及 `SKILL.md`,都没有动。

**为什么改** —— 这条 SELF-REVIEW 谓词比的是两行的值。`mode:subagent` 下左边是分支名、右边
是 session id,两种写法天然不可能相等,所以这条检查在子代理派发的卡上从来不会触发。这不是
漏洞,这就是设计:派发席在档位上席内复核自己派发出去的 PR,独立性由服役档位加记录来保证,
谓词守的是 `mode:remote`——开发会话给自己的 diff 签字——那种情况。但原文没有把这句话写出来,
于是读到这一行的席位会以为自己正在被这条检查看着。写清楚之后,读者知道自己该依赖哪一层
保障。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 代价是那两段被删的尾巴。「值紧跟冒号」的规则本体留着,只删了
理由;「两行皆无的历史裁决恒静默」整条不在了,它描述的是「什么都不发生」,读者不知道它也
不会做错事,而且这个事实仍然活在 `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` 自己打印的结论文本里。上表把
每种写法的字节数都摆出来了:席位只要指着某个数字,就能推翻这次取舍。回滚就是还原这一行,
无依赖、无产物、无发布面。

**席位意见** ——

**你要做的** —— 这是受管面(`.claude/**`),PR 保持 draft,本席位不翻 ready、不入队、不挂
auto-merge。落地路径按受管分层:本 PR 的受管路径全部落在 `pm-dispatch/references/` 之下,
由技能席位在档位上席内复核后落地。
